title: Reconcile a request already covered by existing requirements
actor: An engineer interpreting an incoming request
goal: Establish whether existing requirements already address the request without manufacturing model changes.
context: A request names desired behavior and may suggest a technology; relevant IRs and SRs already exist.
trigger: The engineer submits the request for requirement analysis.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Provides the original request, desired outcome and known constraints.
Presents the affected existing requirement owners and the proposed reuse or change disposition with its basis.
Examines uncovered or conflicting parts and prepares the selected requirement basis for review.

expected_outcome: The original request remains attributable and each material part has a justified disposition; reuse can be the complete proposed result.

alternatives.condition: The request spans several established needs.
alternatives.outcome: The proposed basis identifies the affected owners rather than creating one artificial broad IR.

alternatives.condition: The named technology is a suggestion rather than a required constraint.
alternatives.outcome: The analysis retains the suggestion as source context and distinguishes it from the proposed obligations.

failures.condition: An important constraint or requested outcome conflicts with current requirements.
failures.outcome: The conflict and responsible decision remain explicit; the analysis cannot claim complete reuse or silently omit that part.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.
